meta.product: ASUSE table 34: Estimated Annual Gross Value Added (GVA) Per Establishment (Rs.)
meta.coverage: Estimated Annual Gross Value Added (GVA) Per Establishment (Rs.): every published row, the calendar-year 2025 round
meta.note: The 2025 round covers calendar year 2025 (January to December): a different reference period from the financial-year rounds, so a separate bundle, never joined to them. Every row MoSPI publishes for this table, values as served, including its published "All" totals; each series is named by all of its dimensions. Per-1000 distributions are integers and can miss 1,000 by a few parts from rounding. Rupee values are nominal. The source's HWE and OAE rows of GVA per establishment are mislabelled at All India (the published All reconciles only with the two inverted; see asuse-annual): they are baked here as served, and the curated bundles use the All row only.
